_comment: The layout audit's record file, in the shape of measures.json: the gate is
scripts/layout-audit.mjs (npm run audit:layout), and every silenced finding
is an explicit, reviewable row here rather than a quiet edit to the code.
A waiver needs a `why`. If you cannot write one, it is a bug, not a waiver.
_scenesComment: Each entry boots one scene with one set of DATA. Variants exist because the
defects live in the content, not the code: the longest team name, a tie, a
season game. `teamIdentity: "longest"` seeds recess_team with the widest of
the 56 colour x logo combinations before boot.
_waiversComment: Matched on scene id + the two element labels (order-insensitive) + code.

waivers.why: The school-sign wordmark is 42px type deliberately set on 40px leading. The ink does not touch; only the ink-height boxes do, by 9px. Tightening the leading would be a worse logo.
